changelog: 🗄️ Phase 17 Upgrade: Native SQLite Vector & Document Search Engine (FTS5 + BM25) in Rust.
⚡ BM25 Okapi Inverted Index: Ultra-fast keyword retrieval matching SQLite FTS5 (k1=1.2, b=0.75) with sub-millisecond query execution.
🔍 Hybrid Lexical + Vector Fusion: Reciprocal rank fusion combining lexical BM25 scores with semantic embedding cosine similarity.
